contexts.text: By turns they... remember the things they had done in the life of the body.
From some goods which they remember (there) they want to merit Heaven.
On the remembrance of the things which man has done in the life of the body. General article.
(The Angels) have a most perfect remembrance of past things...
The things which enter (have not) been obliterated when the man no longer remembers them.
In order that they may remember the evils they had done (here).
That they remember the state in which they had been... Signified.
For the sake of perpetual remembrance. Signified.
To write in a book = for perpetual remembrance... For by the Divine remembrance is signified Salvation; and by non-remembrance, damnation. Illustrated.
If a Spirit spoke to a man from his own memory... it would be like the remembrance of a Thing which the man had never heard or seen.
They placed like (images) in their temples, that they might call to remembrance the holy things they signified.
Frequent speech from memory and recollection... induces a species of faith.
When holding forth, things were called into his mind which otherwise he could never remember.
Spirits would communicate things to me... so that I knew no otherwise than that I... remembered them.
Yet as soon as a thing occurs, the (Spirits of Mercury) remember it.
From the remembrance that it is so, the Angels (are) kept in a state of good and truth.
The permanence of these things is memory; and the reproduction of them is remembrance.
